$comment: THREAT-MODEL §3 maps three attack surfaces — ai_docs poisoning, seam fetch fallback, seam-record
poisoning — to the CONTENT-HASH floor primitive, and ARCHITECTURE §5 states the same claim in prose.
Nothing computes that hash: no seam-record*, no `seam-record` or `ai_docs` reference in any shipped
.mjs/.cjs. ARCHITECTURE §5's own marker says it outright — 'no seam-record.json is written and no
ai_docs pin is read by any shipped code today; the live content-hash primitive is spec_content_hash'.
PROBE CHOICE, and its miss. The primitive is a CONTENT-HASH, which is live when shipped code COMPUTES
and COMPARES one — so the probe watches pharn/floor/, where this repo's checkers live (check-seam-config.mjs
is the naming precedent; the `seam-record` substring deliberately does NOT match it). NARROWED, and
stated: an implementation that lands INSIDE an existing file — a new validate.mjs CHECK, or a command
that writes seam-record.json with no new checker — flips no filename probe, so direction 1 stays silent
there. That is the checker's existence-not-function bound, inherited, not a new one.
The two THREAT-MODEL table rows carry a BYTE-IDENTICAL right cell, so each marker spans from its
row-distinctive LEFT cell through the annotation. A marker of the shared cell alone would let one row's
annotation be deleted while the other kept the check green (lessons-learned L36).

is the file a capability author actually reads to learn what `rule_id` guarantees, and it was the site
the earlier repair pass missed while correcting the two ARCHITECTURE ones — so its bytes are registered
here rather than left to the next reader (lessons-learned L2: a contract's honesty travels with the
artifact). The third site is the bound NOTE, registered because 'no roster artifact exists' is itself a
claim that expires the day one lands (L33).

exists'. A roster is a contracts-layer artifact — the archetype-maps entry above registers exactly such

$comment: ARCHITECTURE §5 annotates the constitution prefix, and CONSTITUTION.md § 'How this file is enforced'
confirms the absence in its own words: 'No injector exists: nothing on the floor performs the prepend
and nothing verifies it happened.' Unregistered until the `specified-marker-registration` sweep, which
found it by re-scanning the guarded docs on the shortest invariant substring rather than by trusting
the list of classes it had been handed (lessons-learned L33).
PROBE CHOICE, and it is the WEAKEST of the five — stated plainly rather than left to look equivalent.
An injector would be a prompt-stage hook, so the probe watches .claude/hooks for an *inject* file. But
the prefix is a PROMPT-level mechanism: it could ship purely as a settings.json wiring entry, or stay a
command-level convention, creating no such filename at all — in which case direction 1 never fires for
this entry. Direction 2 (the annotation deleted while no injector exists) is unaffected and is the
direction that matters most here, since the doc is currently HONEST and the risk is losing that.

$forward_claims_comment: FORWARD-LOOKING CLAIMS: sentences that are TRUE when written and become FALSE the moment the named
artifact lands. Computed by the SAME two directions as specified_primitives (a probe + an exact
substring), because the semantics are identical — an expired forward claim IS direction 1, the doc
understating reality. Registered here rather than in a second checker: a parallel manifest+checker
would be a second identity with its own wiring and invoker, which lessons-learned L35 says to
refuse when the existing one already computes the answer.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT REGISTERED, so the absence does not read as an oversight:
* The ~20 P7 'future increment, added when a real need surfaces' statements across
pharn/pharn-review/* and the scan-code-* scanners. Those assert a POLICY (we do not build
speculatively), which stays true whether or not the thing is later built for a real reason.
They are conditional design postures, not pinned predictions; registering them would fire on
correct sentences and train the reader to ignore the check.
* The `live griller runner` class (13+ sites across every griller) and /pharn-verify's verifier
runner. Both are real expiring claims, but neither subject has a NAMED path in this repo, so a
probe would have to invent one. Deferred rather than guessed (P6). Reopens when the runner is
named in a plan or built, or when the first `role: verifier` capability is authored.
An EMPTY forward_claims array is exit 2 (EMPTY_CLASS), never GREEN — per-claim assertions are
vacuously true over zero claims (lessons-learned L34). To express 'none registered', OMIT the key.
